profile.title: Plan your next trip
profile.description: Gather the parks you want to visit, rank them and build each day.

list.title: Your trips
list.description: Find your trip ideas and continue planning them whenever you like.

create.title: Give your next trip a direction
create.description: A title is enough to begin. You can set the dates later.
create.titlePlaceholder: E.g. Theme park weekend in Germany
create.dateHint: Dates are optional and can be changed.

feedback.loadError: Your trips could not be loaded.
feedback.createError: This trip could not be created.
feedback.actionError: This change could not be saved.
feedback.conflict: The trip changed elsewhere. Its latest version has just been reloaded.
feedback.dateRangeTooLong: A trip can cover at most 366 days.
feedback.invalidDates: Enter a start date before the end date and keep them in chronological order.

empty.title: No trip in progress
empty.description: Create a trip to turn your park ideas into a real plan.

overview.description: Shape your ideas into a clear plan at your own pace.

dates.title: Set the trip dates
dates.description: They automatically create the days in your itinerary.
dates.timeZoneHint: Check the park or destination time zone (for example Europe/Paris), especially when planning from another country.
dates.explicitConversion: This proposal stays unchanged until you explicitly choose fixed dates or clear it.
dates.clearBlocked: Clear every saved day and every park date constraint before clearing the trip dates.
dates.dependenciesOutsideRange: The new period must include every saved day and every park date constraint.
dates.unsavedDayOutsideRange: A day has unsaved changes outside this period. Clear or save its draft before changing the dates.
dates.unsavedDayBeforeClear: A day has unsaved changes. Clear or save its draft before clearing the trip dates.

wishlist.title: Start with your saved parks
wishlist.description: Select several favourites or planned visits and add them at once.
wishlist.empty: All available saved parks are already in this trip, or your list is still empty.
wishlist.unavailable: Your lists are temporarily unavailable. You can keep planning the rest of the trip.

candidates.title: Build the trip selection
candidates.description: Drag the cards to rank them, or use their move buttons.
candidates.empty: Add a park from your saved ideas to begin.
candidates.scheduledStateHint: This park is used in a saved day. Clear that day before changing its priority.
candidates.move: Move the park in the list

days.title: Build the trip day by day
days.description: Assign a selected park, an arrival time and a useful note to each date.
days.needsDates: Set the dates first to create the days.
days.needsPark: Mark at least one park as Selected to assign it to a day.
days.noProgram: No itinerary has been set for this day.
